statements.title: Two products live. One in development.
statements.body: QuotesDone and Sonobolt are live on their own sites. MubinFlow is in development.

statements.title: The price comes before the payment.
statements.body: On QuotesDone, the fee is shown in full before you pay. On Sonobolt, the quote is the most you can pay.

statements.title: Your details are not passed around.
statements.body: QuotesDone removes your name before a supplier sees your job. Sonobolt deletes your songs once your mix is ready.

statements.title: An estimate is called an estimate.
statements.body: Guide prices are labelled guides. Tracklist figures are labelled estimates. What is not worked out is listed as not computed.
